title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF supported youth engagement reforms, institutionalizing volunteerism through the PJ-Gouv and youth protection laws. These efforts empowered 575,306 young people with 39,703 leading community actions a 254% increase from 2023. This represents an improvement of 441% since the beginning of the CPD, surpassing targets and fostering social change.
